scope: deterministic balanced engineering stress grid for T0/T1 event timing; deliberately not fitted to the weak venue aggregate

cell_construction.rationale: cover reveal events before, near, and after natural clip completion and deadlines below, overlapping, and above the current full-clip cadence without treating 21 overlapping venue windows as a population distribution

materialization.order: deterministic round-robin over timing_cell x transition_cell, then immutable question rows; no RNG at evaluation
materialization.balance_rule: cell and transition counts may differ by at most one when the requested paper size is not divisible by 24
materialization.question_source: one fresh exact immutable BankExam family shared byte-for-byte by T0/T1, Isaac, and MuJoCo

event_semantics.clock_origin: accepted exact strike opportunity of the previous scheduled question
event_semantics.T0_install: defer atomic next-task installation until natural full-clip wrap but retain the schedule's original reveal and strike deadline for scoring; never shift the deadline
event_semantics.T1_install: at reveal tick atomically install question_id, clip_id, target position/velocity/normal, reveal tick, and immutable next-strike deadline
event_semantics.miss_policy: count the scheduled opportunity as failed and continue the sequence without reset
event_semantics.infeasible_policy: record infeasible on the all-opportunity denominator; do not delay, replace, or censor the row
event_semantics.physical_fall_or_guard_loss: fail the current and all remaining opportunities in that sequence; reset is allowed only at the next immutable sequence boundary
event_semantics.sequence_boundary_reset: one nominal reset before each sequence, identically for T0/T1 and both engines

horizon.reason: expose fifth-and-later opportunity debt in both arms; horizon is shared and therefore not the timing treatment

safety.self_hit_denominator: all simulated control steps and all scheduled opportunities
